task.title: Update HP LaserJet Driver Installation for Windows 11
task.shortdesc: Instructions to install the HP LaserJet driver on Windows 11 and update network timeout settings.

prereq.p: Ensure that your Windows 11 system is up to date and you have administrative privileges.

step.cmd: Download the latest HP LaserJet driver from the HP support website.
step.result: The driver package is saved to your computer.

step.cmd: Double-click the downloaded driver package to start the installation.
Follow the on-screen instructions to complete the installation.
step.result: The driver is installed on your system.

step.cmd: Restart your computer to apply the changes.
step.result: Your system is ready to use the HP LaserJet printer.
